title: Jesus... I Apologised To My Dad And He Left Me On Read
topic: apologised to his father by text and the message was left on read

bible.text: So he got up and went to his father. “But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him and kissed him.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I sent Dad a long apology last night. Why did he leave me on read? 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Two blue ticks this morning. No reply. Not even a thumbs up.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You rewrote that message eleven times. He read it once and went very quiet.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Does quiet mean he's still angry? Or worse, that he doesn't care?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It means a fifty-year-old man holding words he doesn't know how to answer yet. Quiet is not rejection.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Give it today. Then one small line, no speech: I meant it, and I'm here.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I just wanted to hear him say it's okay before I sleep.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: If tonight passes without it, I'm still the Father who saw you coming from a long way off.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: He ran before you finished your speech. So will your dad, in his own time.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What message are you still waiting on? 🙏
